N01.sub: I'm Sunita. Cooking isn't the hard part, ji. The hard part is finding out what to make today.

N02.sub: And every day, one person answered that question. Mummy ji.

N03.sub: Then Vinay bhaiya built Baari. As in... someone else's turn now.

N04.sub: Day one, it learned the house rules. No aloo for Papa ji, less sugar for Mummy ji. It remembers better than I do... that stung a little.

N05.sub: At night, two options. Rajma chawal, or lauki chana dal. And the whole house gets on a call.

N06.sub: Ramen? Pasta? These people are off touring Japan.

N07.sub: Locked. And the rajma-soaking turn... goes to Vinay bhaiya.

N08.sub: ₹28 of tomatoes, Baari just orders. A ₹520 bill? Straight to Vinay bhaiya.

N09.sub: All night, an eye on the parcel. And by morning, it's at the door.

N10.sub: At 7:45, the whole plan, in my language. All I said was this.

N10b.sub: Haan didi, got the tomatoes. Four onions, and there's ginger too.

N11.sub: Baari even counted it. It listens better than Papa ji.

N12.sub: 1 PM, rajma chawal is ready. And Mummy ji?

L10c.sub: We had rajma last week too.

L15.sub: I set it up. And the bill... came to me.

L19.sub: Oh... so now it's my turn... to rest.
